svg.aria-label: Loop press for Inkling 2 Mini (released 20 November 2026). A token carriage rides rails under four layer towers of six layers each, 24 stored layers in total. An orange return bridge loops the token through the middle two towers three times with shared weights, giving 48 layer applications per token. A face-up expert dial reads 8 of 128 experts per token. Numbers: 24 layers, 48 passes, 8 of 128 experts, about 20 GB checkpoint, 1 million token context.
svg.text: NOV 20, 2026 · 24 LAYERS · 48 PASSES · 8/128 EXPERTS · ~20 GB · 1M CTX
